lines: Acclaimed sculptor Hannelore Sinitza has just unveiled a new statue depicting the flag-raising of the new People's Government five years ago.
It features General Svetka Serebryakova, who is now Our Lady, as well as her right-hand Lieutenant General Izolda Zaychik.
The statue is displayed at the new Memorial Garden, located in Marawald, in southern Myrkine.
Visiting hours are from 5 AM to curfew, granted by Our Lady for anyone who would like to pay their respects.
